metadata.label: positive
metadata.reference: A photorealistic city street on a heavily overcast day featuring a parked sedan, an old streetlamp, and a metal trash bin, illuminated by completely diffused light that produces soft, faint, downward contact shadows without strong directional bias, high resolution, no text or watermarks.
metadata.rationale: Diffuse overcast lighting correctly eliminates harsh directional shadows, leaving only subtle, consistent contact shadows directly under objects.
